title: Spent Shortfall on a Store Credit Return
content:
This reconciliation worksheet sets the amount charged to the original card when instant store credit paid on a Returns & Exchanges Store Credit Return has been spent beyond what the return turned out to be owed.

## Spent shortfall

The spent shortfall is:

- the instant credit paid at the first carrier scan,
- less the credit entries on the return (their full totals, merchandise and tax),
- plus the fees withheld on the return,
- less any recovery already entered on the return,
- less the current balance of the Return Store Credit issued for the return,

and it is never below zero.

## Amount charged

The amount charged to the original card is the spent shortfall, rounded half up to the cent.

## Where each figure comes from

| Figure | Record |
|---|---|
| Instant credit paid at the first scan | The return's refund entry for the instant-credit stage |
| Credit entries | The return's credit entries for accepted lines |
| Fees withheld | The return's fee entries |
| Recoveries already entered | The return's instant-credit recovery entries |
| Current balance | The Return Store Credit issued for this return, as held under Gift Cards & Store Credit |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Figure | Case A | Case B |
|---|---|---|
| Instant credit at the first scan | 200.00 | 200.00 |
| Credit entries | 150.00 | 150.00 |
| Fees withheld | 13.50 | 13.50 |
| Recoveries already entered | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Current Return Store Credit balance | 20.00 | 80.00 |
| Spent shortfall | 200.00 less 150.00 plus 13.50 less 20.00, that is 43.50 | 200.00 less 150.00 plus 13.50 less 80.00 is below zero, so 0.00 |
| Amount charged to the original card | 43.50 | 0.00 |

In case B the unspent balance of the Return Store Credit covers the whole difference and nothing has been spent beyond it.
